description: This is a test class for the ClaimDaoExpense class within the OrangeHRM Claim Plugin. It contains unit tests for methods related to ClaimExpense management, such as saving, retrieving, listing, and deleting claim expenses. The class extends KernelTestCase and uses traits for date/time helpers. The test setup involves populating fixture data from a YAML file.

classes.name: ClaimDaoExpenseTest
classes.description: A unit test class for testing Claim Expense DAO operations within the OrangeHRM Claim plugin.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, instantiates ClaimDao, and populates database fixtures from a YAML file.

methods.name: testSaveClaimExpense
methods.description: Tests saving a new ClaimExpense record and verifies the assigned ID.

methods.name: testGetClaimExpenseById
methods.description: Tests retrieving a ClaimExpense by its ID.

methods.name: testGetClaimExpenseList
methods.description: Tests retrieving a list of ClaimExpenses based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: testDeleteClaimExpense
methods.description: Tests deleting ClaimExpenses associated with a specific request ID.
